opportunities.name: Blue card crit hybrid
opportunities.objective: Test blue card crit hybrid against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Blue Card has 1.0 AP and total-AD magic damage plus an explicit crit-chance contribution; Infinity Edge tests that documented critical-damage term, not ordinary spell crit. Rapid Firecannon extends one energized attack while Lich Bane adds an independent magic packet; Statikk retains hybrid attack pressure.
opportunities.requiredState: Lock Blue Card with an energized attack and a safe angle.
opportunities.failure: No Gold Card stun and no percent magic penetration limit safety and tank damage.
opportunities.test: Measure blue, red and gold cards at matched AP with varied crit stats.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: The W formula is a special modifier, not proof Wild Cards randomly crits.

opportunities.name: Destiny on-hit pursuit
opportunities.objective: Test destiny on-hit pursuit against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Stacked Deck grants up to 55% attack speed and AP/AD-scaled magic damage every fourth attack; Nashor, Blade and Terminus support mixed attacks after Gold Card. Hexplate tests using Destiny as a movement/attack window to reposition for those ordinary attacks.
opportunities.requiredState: Arrive safely through R and lock a Gold Card before firing.
opportunities.failure: No burst AP or defensive shield makes a failed arrival fatal.
opportunities.test: Count E procs and Hexplate uptime through R reveal and teleport.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Destiny deals no damage, so ultimate-damage items cannot be assumed to trigger from teleport alone.

ruledOut.reason: The W formula is a special modifier, not proof Wild Cards randomly crits.

unknowns: Current-patch proc ordering/effectiveness is untested; symbolic source stats and helper form/pet records are not runtime dispatch proof.

builds.name: Blue card crit hybrid
builds.summary: Test blue card crit hybrid against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test blue card crit hybrid against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Blue Card has 1.0 AP and total-AD magic damage plus an explicit crit-chance contribution; Infinity Edge tests that documented critical-damage term, not ordinary spell crit. Rapid Firecannon extends one energized attack while Lich Bane adds an independent magic packet; Statikk retains hybrid attack pressure.
testPlan: Required state: Lock Blue Card with an energized attack and a safe angle.
Measure blue, red and gold cards at matched AP with varied crit stats.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: No Gold Card stun and no percent magic penetration limit safety and tank damage.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: The W formula is a special modifier, not proof Wild Cards randomly crits.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Infinity Edge, Rapid Firecannon, Lich Bane, Rabadon's Deathcap, Statikk Shiv, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

Twisted Fate throws three cards that deal [60 / 105 / 150 / 195 / 240 + (0.5) × AD[statFormula=2] + (0.85) × AP] magic damage each.

Twisted Fate focuses on his cards, granting True Sight of all enemy champions on the map for [6 / 8 / 10] seconds and allowing him to Recast.
